label: Sapeornis-inspired broad-winged bird
scope: Original stylized child-friendly scene prop inspired by inventory taxon. Not scientific reconstruction. No inventory approval or publication.
design: Compact tawny and cream feathered body, modest short snout, broad spread feathered wings with separated outer primary tips, graduated fan of tail feathers. Small tucked paired feet. Quiet chest, warm brown flight feathers and cream coverts. No crest or long skeletal tail.
concept_interpretation: Both concept views are oblique, not calibrated orthographic. Author full bilateral wings, feather thickness and rounded underside; do not claim an exact count of fossil feathers. Soaring pose and wing span are artistic approximations.

budgets.runtime_target: Three.js0.180.0; parent independent parse/GPU/scene QA pending

coverage: Eight geometric directions plus clay/alternate key/wire. Static candidate only; pending independent QA.
critical_obligations: Independent identifying silhouette; real body volume and closed thick appendages
Anatomical paired landmark counts stated in design
Source, export and separately executed rebuild parity
Exact exported GLB multi-angle pixels inspected
Honest stylized claim limits and pending external gates
revision_reason: Actual r001 top/bottom pixels show overly pointed narrow outer-wing tips. Broaden primary and secondary feather volumes; keep pose/body/palette. Named visible benefit: coherent broad outer-wing surface with separate rounded feather ends.
